create_source_class: create a Source subclass that defines a plasma source term with a name and affected core profiles
run_source_get_value: run a Source instance's get_value method to compute source profiles for a given time step
test_affected_core_profile_enum: test the AffectedCoreProfile enum to map sources to their evolving core profile equations
review_source_profile_function_protocol: review the SourceProfileFunction Protocol to understand how model-based sources provide profiles
build_source_zero_mode: build a Source configured in ZERO mode to return zero-valued source profiles across all affected core profiles
